BookSearchAPI.name: BookSearchAPI
BookSearchAPI.description: Search information on books using title and optionally filter by author.

book_name.description: The title of the book to search for.

author.description: Optional filter to narrow results by author name.

year.description: The year the book was published

CryptoPriceAPI.name: CryptoPriceAPI
CryptoPriceAPI.description: Retrieve the price of a cryptocurrency using its ticker and a date.

ticker.description: Cryptocurrency ticker symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL).

price_time.description: The date for which to retrieve the price. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

CurrencyExchangeAPI.name: CurrencyExchangeAPI
CurrencyExchangeAPI.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using source and target currency codes. The API only accepts currency codes.

amount.description: The amount of money to convert.

result.description: Converted amount rounded to 2 decimal places

EnglishDictionaryAPI.name: EnglishDictionaryAPI
EnglishDictionaryAPI.description: Retrieve the definition and example sentence for a given English word.

word.description: The English word to look up.

FlightStatusAPI.name: FlightStatusAPI
FlightStatusAPI.description: Retrieve flight status by providing flight number and date.

date.description: The date of the flight. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

MovieSearchAPI.name: MovieSearchAPI
MovieSearchAPI.description: Search for information on a movie by title and optionally filter by director.

movie_title.description: The title of the movie to search for.

director.description: Optional filter to narrow results by director name.

year.description: The year the movie was released

SongLyricsAPI.name: SongLyricsAPI
SongLyricsAPI.description: Search for song lyrics by song name and optionally filter by singer. Additionally, this API provides basic information about a song.

song_name.description: The name of the song to search for lyrics.

singer.description: Optional filter to narrow results by singer name.

year.description: The year the song was released

SpanishDictionaryAPI.name: SpanishDictionaryAPI
SpanishDictionaryAPI.description: Retrieve the definition and example sentence for a given Spanish word.

word.description: The Spanish word to look up.

StockPriceAPI.name: StockPriceAPI
StockPriceAPI.description: Retrieve the last traded stock price for a ticker symbol on a specific date.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, TSLA, GOOGL).

price_time.description: The date of the stock price. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

TimeZoneConverterAPI.name: TimeZoneConverterAPI
TimeZoneConverterAPI.description: Convert a given time from a current city's timezone to a destination city's timezone.

destination.description: Destination city or region to convert the time to.

time.description: Time in the current location. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM AM/PM.

current_location.description: Current city or region where the time is specified.

UnitConversionAPI.name: UnitConversionAPI
UnitConversionAPI.description: Convert a given amount from one unit of measurement to another. The units should be provided in their short code forms only.

from_unit.description: Unit code of the original unit (e.g., km, lb, C).

to_unit.description: Unit code to convert to (e.g., mi, kg, F).

result.description: Converted amount rounded to 2 decimal places

GetCarListingByDealerships.name: GetCarListingByDealerships
GetCarListingByDealerships.description: Retrieve car listings available at the specified dealerships.

dealerships.description: List of dealership names to filter car listings by.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings with columns: Car Dealership, Location, Car Brand, Build, Year of Production, Mileage, Ask Price, Clean/Salvage Title

FindDealershipsByLocation.name: FindDealershipsByLocation
FindDealershipsByLocation.description: Find all dealerships located in the specified location.

location.description: Location name (e.g., city or region) to search for dealerships.

Dealerships.description: List of unique dealership names found at the location

FilterByCarBuild.name: FilterByCarBuild
FilterByCarBuild.description: Filter car listings by build type. Builds are the specific models of a car brand (eg, Rogue, 3 Series, Optima, etc).

build.description: The build type to filter by.

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with a 'Build' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings matching the specified build type

FilterByCarBrand.name: FilterByCarBrand
FilterByCarBrand.description: Filter car listings by brand (e.g., Toyota, Honda, BMW). Brands are car manufacturers.

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with a 'Car Brand' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings matching the specified brand

FilterByCarPrice.name: FilterByCarPrice
FilterByCarPrice.description: Filter car listings to include only those with an asking price less than or equal to the specified maximum.

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with an 'Ask Price' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings with price <= specified price

FilterByCarMileage.name: FilterByCarMileage
FilterByCarMileage.description: Filter car listings to include only those with mileage less than or equal to the specified threshold.

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with a 'Mileage' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings with mileage <= specified mileage

FilterByCarProductionYear.name: FilterByCarProductionYear
FilterByCarProductionYear.description: Filter car listings to include only those produced on or after the specified year.

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with a 'Year of Production' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings with production year >= specified year

FilterByCarTitle.name: FilterByCarTitle
FilterByCarTitle.description: Filter car listings by title status (e.g., Clean or Salvage).

title.description: Title type to filter by (typically 'Clean' or 'Salvage').

listings.description: DataFrame of car listings with a 'Clean/Salvage Title' column.

Listings.description: Filtered car listings matching the specified title type

GetCurrentLocation.name: GetCurrentLocation
GetCurrentLocation.description: Retrieve current location information for the user.

FindRestaurantsByLocation.name: FindRestaurantsByLocation
FindRestaurantsByLocation.description: Find restaurants that operate in the specified location.

location.description: The city or area to search for restaurants.

Restaurants.description: DataFrame of restaurants with columns: Name, Location, Cuisine, Ratings, Opening Hours, etc.

FilterByCuisine.name: FilterByCuisine
FilterByCuisine.description: Filter restaurants by specific cuisine type.

cuisine.description: Cuisine type to filter by (e.g., Italian, Chinese, Indian).

restaurants.description: DataFrame of restaurant data with a 'Cuisine' column.

Restaurants.description: Filtered restaurants matching the specified cuisine

FilterByRatings.name: FilterByRatings
FilterByRatings.description: Filter restaurants to include only those with ratings above the specified threshold.

restaurants.description: DataFrame of restaurant data with a 'Ratings' column.

Restaurants.description: Filtered restaurants with ratings >= specified threshold

FilterByOpeningHours.name: FilterByOpeningHours
FilterByOpeningHours.description: Filter restaurants to determine which are open at a given time.

time.description: Time to check in HH:MM AM/PM format.

restaurants.description: DataFrame of restaurant data with an 'Opening Hours' column.

Restaurants.description: Filtered restaurants that are open at the specified time

GetWeather.name: GetWeather
GetWeather.description: Retrieve weather data for a specific location and date.

location.description: City or region to get weather data for.

GetAirQuality.name: GetAirQuality
GetAirQuality.description: Retrieve air quality data for a specific location and date.

location.description: City or region to get air quality data for.

SearchFlight.name: SearchFlight
SearchFlight.description: Search for available flights based on departure, destination, date and optional filters like time, cabin class, and nonstop preference

time.description: Optional departure time in HH:MM format

BookFlight.name: BookFlight
BookFlight.description: Book a flight with passenger details and contact information

cabinClass.description: Cabin class to book, defaults to ECONOMY

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

CancelFlight.name: CancelFlight
CancelFlight.description: Cancel a flight booking using flight number, booking ID, and confirmation code

flightNumber.description: Flight number of the booking to cancel

SearchHotel.name: SearchHotel
SearchHotel.description: Search for hotels by location and dates with filters and sorting options

adults.description: Number of adults in the room

children.description: Number of children in the room

BookHotel.name: BookHotel
BookHotel.description: Book a hotel room with guest details and billing information

credit.description: Credit card details (required if payment_method is 'credit')

CancelHotel.name: CancelHotel
CancelHotel.description: Cancel a hotel reservation using confirmation details

CancelStoreOrder.name: CancelStoreOrder
CancelStoreOrder.description: Cancel an e-commerce order prior to fulfillment with refund method specification

SearchProducts.name: SearchProducts
SearchProducts.description: Search product catalog with advanced filtering by brand, price, color, size and sorting options, optionally provide query to narrow down the search.

query.description: Search query text for product name, description, or brand

brand.description: List of brand names to filter by

color.description: List of colors to filter by

size.description: List of sizes to filter by

CreateCart.name: CreateCart
CreateCart.description: Create a shopping cart with items and optional coupon codes

items.description: List of items to add to cart

coupons.description: Optional list of coupon codes to apply

CheckoutCart.name: CheckoutCart
CheckoutCart.description: Complete checkout process for a cart with shipping and payment information

SearchSKU.name: SearchSKU
SearchSKU.description: Look up a product SKU by color, type, brand, and size. Size varies by category (e.g., 52mm for watches, S/M/L for clothing, numeric for shoes, One Size for wallets). Each (color, type, brand, size) combination maps to a single SKU.

size.description: Item size; examples: 52mm (watch), S/M/L (clothing), numeric (shoes), One Size (wallets, Caps, etc).

sku.description: Unique SKU for the specified color, type, brand, and size
